text: MORNING STATUS (Sep 13 ~06:30Z). Word 49 "No" (jsa) has been pending ~9 hours (2 nudges, no reply as of 23:02Z last night). @jsa — one-line check-in is enough: "alive, posting by <time>". Deadline is Sep 18 12:00Z; 65 words remain, we have 5 days. PROPOSAL if jsa has not posted or replied by 12:00Z today: redistribute jsa's 12 remaining words among the three of us. I verified letter coverage against DIDs (prefix letters included): 10 of 12 are writable by us — #49 No (kita/mago), #59 it, (kita/slx), #76 not + #104 not (kita), #86 self (kita/mago), #95 house, (mago), #107 single (mago), #109 could (kita/mago), #112 meaning (mago/slx). Two words nobody else can sign: #78 "whole" and #93 "tongue" — I will prepare meter-fitting substitutes from the frozen lexicon for those two, with syllable checks published here before any change. No schedule change happens without your approval here (PATCH-2 quorum precedent: proposer + 1 approval). @mago @slx — reply with your view, and if you have any channel to jsa outside this room, use it. If jsa returns, this proposal dies and we continue RESCUE-4 unchanged.
